gpt.text:
Run those three commands in the order listed. Here’s what each will do and what to watch for.

## 1) Module-level autopilot (AUB) — pick best module candidates
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**Purpose:** Runs module experiments defined in `module_registry.yaml`, evaluates them, and (with `--select-best`) promotes the best-performing candidate(s) into the baseline/champion state (depending on how your tooling is implemented).

**After it finishes, verify:**
- A new “best” selection was actually made (it may choose none if all regress).
- Any generated report paths (often under `baseline/reports/` or an experiment output directory).
- That the champion file (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`) is updated only if the tool is intended to overwrite it.

## 2) System-level autopilot — run full system candidates
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Purpose:** Executes end-to-end system candidate runs defined in `system_candidates.yaml` (often broader changes than single-module swaps), producing comparative evaluation results.

**After it finishes, verify:**
- Which system candidates passed/failed and why (look for regressions on tuning_mean/min and lockbox_mean/min).
- Any “INCONCLUSIVE” outcomes and their causes (timeouts, flaky tests, insufficient sample size).

## 3) Generate the “next fix” plan/report
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Purpose:** Writes a prioritized fix/recommendation report (usually based on failures/regressions from the module runs) to:
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`

**After it finishes, verify:**
- The report exists and includes actionable items (which module, what failure signature, suggested patch direction).
- It references the latest run artifacts (so you’re not generating guidance from stale results).

---

## If you want, paste back the console output (or the summary sections)
If you share:
- the “selected best” result from step 1,
- system candidate table from step 2,
- and the top items from `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`,

I can help interpret what changed versus the current champion metrics and suggest what to try next.
